question: what is this company worth, and what does the price already assume?

Under valuation.missing the calculator prints: "WACC is not computed: the cost of equity needs a beta and a price: no price series was given: the forward track's price source is Tiingo, and without its token no series is fetched". Under cost_of_capital.missing it prints: "the cost of equity needs a beta and a price: no price series was given: the forward track's price source is Tiingo, and without its token no series is fetched". So there is no value range, and no enterprise value, equity value or value per share for any scenario; none is given here. Part of the cost of capital is on record: the risk-free rate {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate|pct}, the equity risk premium {cost_of_capital.equity_risk_premium|pct} and the tax rate {cost_of_capital.tax_rate|pct}. Beta and the market value of equity are missing. Year-end debt is {terms.debt_now}, and the calculator says the cost of debt carries "no weight", so the whole discount rate depends on the missing cost of equity. The bridge from enterprise value to equity value is on record too: net debt of {ratios.solvency.net_debt}, which is a net cash position, an operating lease liability of {terms.balances_now.operating_lease_liability} and {terms.shares_outstanding} shares outstanding. That net cash is measured at year end, before the Thai term loan and the California building that came after it. What can be read is my drivers against the record. The base case starts revenue growth below the trailing year's {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct} but above the three-year compound {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct}. It holds operating margin at the three-year average {earnings_versus_cash.history.operating_margin_three_year_average|pct}, and in year one it reinvests just under all of after-tax operating income. That is set against a fiscal 2026 in which free cash flow to the firm was {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm}. The bear case starts growth below fiscal 2023's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.revenue_growth|pct} and lets margin fall to about fiscal 2021's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.5.operating_margin|pct}. The bull case starts growth above the trailing year and carries margin above fiscal 2026's record {ratios.profitability.operating_margin|pct}. All three terminal rates sit below the risk-free rate.

Revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct} in fiscal 2026, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.revenue_growth|pct} in fiscal 2025 and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.revenue_growth|pct} in fiscal 2024. The three-year compound rate is {implied_growth_beside_history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct} and the five-year rate {implied_growth_beside_history.revenue_growth_five_year_compound|pct}. Fourth-quarter revenue of fiscal 2026 was {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter}, up {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} on a year earlier. The company guides the first quarter of fiscal 2027 to a range above that figure (quoted below). That guidance covers one quarter, and MD&A warns that "Our industry is characterized by rapid technological change, short-term customer commitments, and rapid changes in demand." My base case starts growth below the trailing year and above both compound rates, then fades it to a terminal rate below the risk-free rate {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate|pct}. most_sensitive.assumption: revenue growth in year one, and its fade to the terminal rate
most_sensitive.reading: The sensitivity grid was not computed. The valuation block holds only the reason "WACC is not computed" and nothing under it, so no sensitivity is measured here. What can be read is where my own scenarios spread widest against the record. First-year growth runs from a bear case below fiscal 2023's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.revenue_growth|pct} to a bull case above the trailing year's {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}. The record itself moved from fiscal 2024's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.revenue_growth|pct} to that trailing rate within two years. Python fades growth in a straight line over ten years, so the first-year choice carries into every year of the forecast and compounds into the revenue the terminal value rests on. Every scenario also reinvests most or all of after-tax operating income in year one, after a fiscal 2026 in which free cash flow to the firm was {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm}. Near-term cash therefore adds little, and value leans on those later, compounded years.

accounting_adjustments.reading: None moved value: no value was computed, and no adjustment was written. The accounting analysis lists its adjustments as empty. The calculator's quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted} deducts only share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} and applies no other adjustment. The accounting analysis names items that would lower cash-based value if they were calculator fields, and says why they are not adjusted. On the unpaid Pillar Two tax inside operating cash flow of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow}, it says: "The change in tax payable is not a calculator field, so no adjustment is written." The same applies to capital spending incurred but not yet paid, which flatters free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}, and to the customer warrant added back as non-cash. The one-time Raytek gain sits below operating income, so it does not reach drivers built on operating margin. The tax rate of {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct} carries Pillar Two but not the end of the Chonburi exemption. On that count, a valuation run on it would overstate after-tax value in every scenario.

summary_ko.value_range: 주가 시계열과 베타가 없어 자기자본비용과 가중평균자본비용(WACC)을 계산하지 못했고, 그래서 시나리오별 기업가치와 주당가치 범위도 나오지 않았습니다. 무위험이자율 {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate|pct}, 주식위험프리미엄 {cost_of_capital.equity_risk_premium|pct}, 순부채 {ratios.solvency.net_debt}(순현금)는 기록에 있지만 베타와 주가가 빠져 있습니다.
summary_ko.price_position: 결산 기준일의 주가가 계산 파일에 없어서 가격이 가치 범위의 어디에 있는지 읽을 수 없습니다. 다만 기업잉여현금흐름이 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm}로 음수여서, 어떤 가격이든 지난 현금이 아니라 앞으로 벌어들일 현금에 대한 값입니다.
summary_ko.market_implied_growth: 역DCF가 계산되지 않아 시장 가격이 가정하는 성장률은 알 수 없습니다. 비교 기준으로 매출은 최근 연도에 {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}, 최근 삼 년 연평균 {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct} 성장했고, 회사는 다음 분기 매출 가이던스를 넷째 분기 매출 {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter}보다 높게 제시했습니다.
summary_ko.most_sensitive: 민감도 표가 계산되지 않아 측정된 민감도는 없습니다. 제 시나리오 사이에서 가장 크게 벌어지는 가정은 첫해 매출 성장률(약세는 fiscal 2023의 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.revenue_growth|pct}보다 낮고 강세는 최근 연도 {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}보다 높음)과, 이력 최저 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.5.operating_margin|pct}부터 최고 {ratios.profitability.operating_margin|pct} 위까지 걸친 영업이익률 경로입니다.
summary_ko.accounting_adjustments: 가치가 계산되지 않았고 회계 분석도 조정을 하지 않았으므로, 회계 조정이 가치를 움직인 크기는 없습니다. 다만 미납 Pillar Two 세금과 미지급 설비투자처럼 계산 파일에 필드가 없어 조정하지 못한 항목이 현금흐름을 좋아 보이게 하고, 세율 {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}에는 촌부리 면세 종료가 반영되지 않았습니다.

limits: This valuation is a set of stated assumptions run through a stated formula. It states no recommendation to trade, and a different reader choosing different drivers would reach a different value.
